summary: Summoning jurisdiction under PMLA: Delhi court's jurisdiction upheld; compliance with summons issued to Kolkata residents; use of s.50 PMLA for personal appearance; territorial jurisdiction consistency with article 21; applicability of crpc s.160 protections; intra-court procedure validity; dismissal of writ petitions upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.50, s.63(4), s.65
Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 s.4(2), s.91, s.160, s.190(1)(a), s.200
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court orders upholding summons and cognizance maintained.
